summary: This is a Snowflake documentation page for the SHOW SHARES IN FAILOVER GROUP command, which lists the shares in a failover group. The command requires Business Critical Edition or higher and a role with OWNERSHIP or MONITOR privilege on the failover group. Results are returned only for a role holding the MONITOR privilege on a share, and an example lists the shares in a failover group named myrg.
one_line: Snowflake reference for the SHOW SHARES IN FAILOVER GROUP command, which lists shares in a failover group.
key_facts: The SHOW SHARES IN FAILOVER GROUP command lists shares in a failover group.
The command requires Business Critical Edition (or higher).
Syntax is SHOW SHARES IN FAILOVER GROUP <name>.
The name parameter specifies the identifier for the failover group.
Executing SHOW SHARES IN FAILOVER GROUP requires a role with either the OWNERSHIP or MONITOR privilege on the failover group.
The command returns results only for a role with the MONITOR privilege on a share.
The example command SHOW SHARES IN FAILOVER GROUP myrg; lists the shares in the failover group myrg.
To upgrade to Business Critical Edition, users are directed to contact Snowflake Support.
The page is listed under the Replication section, within the Failover/Failback subsection, and the Client Redirect subsection.
The page includes a 'Was this page helpful?' feedback prompt, which is page boilerplate and not content.
